subject: Request to shift Thursday project review
text: Hello Priya, I hope this message finds you well. I am writing because our scheduled project review on Thursday at 2 p.m. may need to shift by about forty-five minutes. This morning my laptop’s audio driver began behaving strangely, and although the microphone now works intermittently, I do not want to risk a poor connection during a discussion where we need to clarify several deliverables. I also checked the campus computer lab, but every workstation I reserved is occupied until the early evening. Because the issue is small and likely temporary, I wanted to alert you early rather than discover the problem after the meeting begins. The notes and charts are already prepared, so the change would not affect our readiness for Friday. If you prefer, I can send a brief update beforehand so we can use the limited time efficiently. I can also test the connection in the student center before our new start time and call you if anything remains unresolved. Would 2:45 p.m. work for you, or would a later slot such as 3:30 p.m. be easier? If either option is inconvenient, I can also come to your office for an in-person conversation instead, which may be the simplest solution if my equipment remains unreliable. I apologize for the short notice and for any inconvenience caused by this unexpected technical detail. Please let me know which time you would prefer, and I will update the calendar invitation as soon as possible. Thank you for your understanding, and I appreciate your patience with this minor complication.
